story.missionBrief:
=== MISSION BRIEFING ===
Role: Data Transport Specialist
Type: DELIVERY

Objective: Deliver encrypted data packet through 5 security checkpoints
Location: Neon District data highways, Sector 7
Threat: Corporate hunter-killbots tracking your signal
Method: Phase through barriers while maintaining stealth
Time Constraint: 60 seconds before packet auto-decrypts

=== AVAILABLE ABILITIES ===
• Glitch Step: Phase through one security barrier (5 seconds cooldown)
• Packet Shield: Brief invulnerability while carrying data (10 seconds cooldown)
• Tracer Ghost: Leave a decoy signal to mislead pursuers [Single use per mission]

=== STAKES ===
Success: Critical intel reaches resistance safely
Failure: Data falls into corporate hands, mission compromised
